description: No qualified physical-baseline observations are currently populated. Add only independently measured distances with traceable endpoint coordinate records, published uncertainty, and site-level holdout grouping.

measurementPolicy.splitPolicy: Assign entire survey baselines or sites to train or holdout before fitting. Never split segments from one baseline across the two groups.
measurementPolicy.sourcePolicy: Record the actual survey certificate or row and coordinate reference for each exact monument. Approximate site positions are ineligible.

sourceReview.reportedCoverage: More than 400 EDMI calibration baselines across the United States
sourceReview.publishedProducts: Site descriptions and adjusted calibration-baseline measurements; state data files
sourceReview.status: high-quality local lengths; not fit-ready as geographic anchors without a separate, traceable coordinate survey for each exact monument
importConditions: select the published horizontal adjusted distance, not the mark-to-mark slope distance
obtain exact horizontal coordinates for the same monument marks from a separate traceable coordinate survey
record coordinate uncertainty and reference frame/epoch for each mark
retain published distance uncertainty, instrument and observation epoch
split complete baseline sites between training and holdout
sourceReview.publishedConfiguration: A standard line uses four marks at approximately 0, 150, 430 and 1400 m; published products include adjusted distances between mark pairs, descriptions and elevation differences.
sourceReview.measurementBasisNote: NGS publishes both mark-to-mark and horizontal distances; only the horizontal values are compatible with this fitter.
sourceReview.coordinateQuality: NGS states accurate horizontal or vertical positions are not normally available for CBL marks. The CBL site map position or general location description is not exact monument coordinate data.

sourceReview.reportedCoverage: Observation pillars span 24 m to 864 m; the published full-line 2013 result is 864122.9 mm ±0.1 mm
sourceReview.status: high-accuracy local length source; not fit-ready until exact coordinates are sourced for the underground marker endpoints, not just the observation pillars
importConditions: identify whether each published distance refers to a pillar centre or an underground baseline marker
obtain exact coordinate references for the physical endpoints used by the length certificate
record coordinate reference frame, epoch and uncertainty
use the certified distance and its stated uncertainty
keep the complete Nummela site in one validation split
sourceReview.pillarAndMarkNote: The 2026 FIG paper describes six EDM observation pillars at 0, 24, 72, 216, 432 and 864 m, while the precision baseline itself is preserved between six underground markers about 2 m from the pillar line. The pillar coordinates, if sourced, are not automatically coordinates of the physical baseline endpoints.
sourceReview.undergroundMarkerNote: The underground marker line is checked annually with theodolite-based projection measurements; the paper reports up to 0.2 mm standard uncertainty for that connection.

sourceReview.provider: Warsaw University of Technology and independent verification partners
sourceReview.reportedCoverage: 5 km reference baseline; uncertainty below 1 mm (k=2), measured through repeated GNSS and EDM campaigns and independently verified
sourceReview.status: high-accuracy local length source; preliminary published positions are approximate; final exact mark coordinates and final reference-distance tables required before import
importConditions: extract the final reference distance table from the 2026 publication
obtain precise coordinates for each exact pillar/monument mark from the final GNSS adjustment or official source
do not reuse the 2022 approximate point coordinates as fitting positions
record reference frame, epoch and coordinate uncertainty for each point
keep the complete EURO5000 site in one validation split
sourceReview.preliminaryMeasurement: A 2022 preliminary study reports an EDM EUR1–EUR2 length of 5177.1758 m ±0.0073 m (k=1).
sourceReview.coordinateQuality: The same preliminary study labels its five point coordinates approximate; those coordinates are not accepted as precise fitting anchors.
